title: API database authentication failure
alert: The shop homepage loads, but any page needing the database shows 'Service unavailable'. The API health check is failing.

truth.root_cause: The new api 2.3.2 image has a typo in the DATABASE_PASSWORD environment variable, so the Python app cannot authenticate to PostgreSQL. The container stays running but every database request fails.
truth.fix: Roll back the api container to 2.3.1, then verify the health endpoint and product pages work again.
